understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete the KA59 puzzle game by solving each level: place every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with '+' so that all goals are occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN and progress until the final run reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn/step-limited per level. Directional MOVE actions would move the currently selected piece on the grid until blocked by walls/obstacles (and in some cases could push movable blocks if aligned and space permitted). CLICK selected/teleported the active controllable piece to the clicked selectable piece’s position (switching which piece you control), using the same coordinate system as the player/object positions. Walls/obstacles prevented movement or placement; attempted moves/clicks into blocked/invalid targets resulted in no change while still consuming a step.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete the KA59 puzzle game by solving each level: place every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with '+' so that all goals are occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN and progress until the final run reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn/step-limited per level. Directional MOVE actions would move the currently selected piece on the grid until blocked by walls/obstacles (and in some cases could push movable blocks if aligned and space permitted). CLICK selected/teleported the active controllable piece to the clicked selectable piece’s position (switching which piece you control), using the same coordinate system as the player/object positions. Walls/obstacles prevented movement or placement; attempted moves/clicks into blocked/invalid targets resulted in no change while still consuming a step.
